subject: Hosted API pricing — monthly burn shape, peak TPS, and budget range
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@novusai.com>, NovusAI Procurement <procurement@novusai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing — monthly burn shape, peak TPS, and budget range

Hi Alyssa / procurement team — thanks for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can put a concrete hosted quote together.

Call highlights (what I captured):
- Primary workload: multi-turn conversational assistant with some longer context windows (usages include chat + structured summaries).
- Expected steady-state monthly tokens: 30M–60M (range you mentioned).
- Typical request size: ~1k tokens in/1k tokens out on average (so ~2k tokens per API call on average).
- Observed peak windows: 20–40 TPS sustained for 10–90 minutes daily (you mentioned short bursts are common during product events).
- Budget target you called out: ~$700–$900 per 1M tokens (targeting predictable unit economics).
- Compliance: SOC 2 and basic network controls required; you flagged procurement timelines (end of month) and a short vendor questionnaire.

Open items we need to confirm before we finalise pricing options:
1) Can you confirm the realistic monthly floor (if you had to pick a committed monthly number) — e.g., 40M vs 60M?
2) Peak TPS: should we plan for a 35 TPS sustained burst for 30 minutes as a conservative engineering assumption?
3) Do you have a hard $/1M upper bound for hosted (beyond the $700–$900 range)?
4) Procurement timeline and PO/contract owner (procurement@novusai.com OK?)

Next steps from our side: I attached a preliminary hosted quote (redwood-hosted-quote-DEV-11324.pdf) and a short "consumption profile" workbook (novus-monthly-profile-v2.xlsx) where we modeled a few burn shapes and unit prices. I’ll wait on your confirmation of the items above and procurement contact to produce a binding quote and DocuSign.

Proposed quick options (high-level):
- Option A: 12-month commit @ 50M/mo floor, $740 per 1M tokens, includes 2x burst credits for daily peak windows and 99.9% API uptime SLA.
- Option B: No commit / month-to-month with tiered unit pricing starting at $920 per 1M tokens, automatic throttled burst allowance, higher per-unit cost.

If those look reasonable I can turn Option A into a formal quote for signature. Would you be free for a 20-minute follow-up tomorrow to lock the floor and peak assumptions?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-hosted-quote-DEV-11324.pdf (summary quote)
Attachment: novus-monthly-profile-v2.xlsx (consumption scenarios)

From: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@novusai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovusAI Procurement <procurement@novusai.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — monthly burn shape, peak TPS, and budget range

Thanks Marissa — solid recap, appreciate the workbook. A few clarifications and confirmations from our side:

Confirmed numbers:
- Revised steady-state monthly tokens: 30M–50M (we trimmed the top end after reviewing internal dashboards).
- Average per-call consumption: closer to 2.2k tokens total (1.1k in + 1.1k out) given our richer context retention.
- Peak profile: peaks can spike to ~35 TPS but typically those are short (15–45 minutes). We do see one larger event per month which could sustain ~50 TPS for ~10–15 minutes.
- Budget: we'd like to keep unit economics around $750 per 1M tokens if possible — anything above $850/monthly unit is a stretch for our current fiscal plan.

Compliance/procurement:
- Procurement contact: procurement@novusai.com (CC'd) — lead is Daniel Hsu (daniel.h@novusai.com).
- We'll need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an answers doc for a standard vendor security questionnaire.

Ask: can you add a "peak-surge" clause to Option A that covers the monthly large event (50 TPS for 15 mins)? We want to avoid throttling during that event.

I've attached an updated consumption sheet on our side (Novus_profile_v2.xlsx) with the event spike included — that should help map 1M token impacts across our feature surface.

If you can push a revised quote that targets $750/1M with the surge clause and 99.9% SLA, procurement will review it this week. Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow at 11am PT.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Morgan | Head of Product, Novus AI
alyssa@novusai.com

Attachment: Novus_profile_v2.xlsx (consumption + event spike)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — monthly burn shape, peak TPS, and budget range

Karthik — forwarding Alyssa's clarifications. Key asks: target $750/1M (we should try to hit this with a 12mo commit), a "peak-surge" clause for one large monthly event (~50 TPS for 15 mins), and SOC 2 artifacts.

Quick notes for pricing:
- If we assume 50M/mo commit, $740/1M in Option A is borderline; can we structure a small monthly burst credit bucket to cover the one big event and keep effective unit under $750?
- If not, we can propose a blended effective rate: 48M committed with a 5% monthly overage credit for bursts.

Engineering ask: will 50 TPS sustained for 15 mins + 35 TPS 45 mins daily be reasonable with the hosted routing and our burst buffer? Jordan, can you confirm router/burst behavior and whether we need a Dedicated fallback in the proposal?

If this looks good I’ll send the revised quote and include the SOC 2 packet link.

—Marissa

Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Hosted API pricing — monthly burn shape, peak TPS, and budget range

Hi Alyssa / Daniel — thanks for the clarifications and the updated profile. We reviewed internally and prepared a revised hosted proposal that tries to match your $750/1M target while covering the monthly large event. Summary below — full quote attached.

Revised Option A (recommended):
- Commitment: 12 months, 48M tokens/month committed baseline.
- Unit price: $745 per 1M tokens (applies to committed baseline).
- Burst/surge protection: monthly surge bucket equals 3M tokens (sized to cover the monthly 50 TPS x 15 min event in the profile). Any additional overage billed at $980/1M.
- SLA: 99.9% uptime, with automated fallback to lower-latency model variant if necessary (we document degradation policy in the SOW).
- Security: SOC 2 Type II evidence attached; we will fill your vendor questionnaire by EOD tomorrow.

Option B (no-commit):
- No minimum; $920 per 1M tokens. Burst handled inline but no dedicated surge credits.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm procurement owner (Daniel Hsu) and whether a PO will be submitted or if you prefer DocuSign route.
2) If Daniel confirms, I’ll push a DocuSign with Option A and SOW + SOC 2 packet.
3) We can schedule a short tech sync for Jordan to walk your infra team through the surge behavior — available Tue/Wed.

If this looks good, I’ll issue the DocuSign later today. Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
